I created a clean, professional **Partnership Performance Tracker spreadsheet** that your client can use immediately to manage and evaluate every partnership.

### What’s included in the spreadsheet
Each row represents one partner. Columns track:

- Partnership Name  
- Number of referrals / leads generated  
- Conversion rate of referrals  
- Revenue generated per partnership  
- Student satisfaction with partner services (1–10)  
- Partner satisfaction with quality of referrals (1–10)  
- Time to first conversion (days)  
- Lifetime value of referred customers  
- Notes / insights  

This is structured so it works equally well for:
- Product distributors  
- Software and POS partners  
- Med spa chains  
- Equipment vendors  
- Coaches, insurers, and associations  

It also makes it very easy to show **proof of ROI** when renegotiating or expanding partnerships.

### Download the spreadsheet
[Download the Partnership Performance Tracker](sandbox:/mnt/data/AIA_Partnership_Performance_Tracker.xlsx)

- Add **formulas** (auto-calculated totals, averages, ROI)  
- Create a **dashboard view** (executive summary for Tracy)  
- Customize versions for different partner types  
- Turn this into a **Google Sheet** with share permissions  

Just tell me how polished you want the final client-facing version.
